_why: Owner 2026-10-28 (v3 cutover, V3_CUTOVER_MIGRATE_BENCH_LANE_TO_FOUNDRY): "Once we switch over to Conductor + ispatch + Foundry, all bench items get reassigned to Dispatch-> Foundry." Every FlowWorks and Gimme Some Slack (GSS) item belongs to the seat in `seat` (FOUNDRY since the cutover): build, art, live testing, acceptance, code review, deploys; BENCH (the Conductor's window) takes only an item that needs the owner live (needs=owner). rimflow reads this file in `file` (a FlowWorks id filed for another seat is filed for `seat`) and in `acceptance` (a FlowWorks item is swept by `seat` at every level). `v3_cutover.py revert` flips `seat` back to BENCH. Match is on the item ID; add a pattern when a FlowWorks item slips through.
